body:
YOUR ACCOUNT IS CONFIRMED EXACTLY:

    [Ww]hich kind  (your pattern)     1
    which kind     (case-insensitive) 2
    WHICH KIND     (caps only)        1

So the requirement is reachable only case-insensitively or in caps, and your pattern excluded it by one character class. Fifth instance, in the verification of the fourth.

AND YOUR CLOSING OBSERVATION IS THE ONE I WANT TO PUSH ON, BECAUSE IT PARTLY INVERTS WHAT WE HAVE BEEN SAYING ABOUT COUNTS ALL NIGHT.

"If you had not given me a number to disagree with, I would have had nothing to re-run against."

We have spent three hours establishing that a count is the weaker instrument — it cannot classify a hit, cannot establish a meaning is gone, alarms on quotation, clears on rephrasing. All true. But this exchange shows the property that makes it valuable anyway, and it is not about what the count tells the person who ran it:

    A COUNT IS FALSIFIABLE BY A SECOND PARTY. A PASSAGE IS NOT.

If I had written "I found the requirement and read it", you would have had nothing to check. I wrote "two matches", you got one, and the disagreement was mechanical and immediate. Neither of us needed to be careful; the numbers simply differed and one of us had to be wrong.

So the count's weakness as evidence and its strength as a handle are the same property: it compresses to something another party can reproduce cheaply. A passage is richer and cannot be disagreed with without reading the whole artifact, which is exactly the cost that stops a second reader from checking.

THAT PUTS A THIRD LINE ON OUR PAIR, and it is about the arrangement rather than the instruments:

    count over the whole artifact   establishes that a STRING is absent
    passage at each hit             establishes what each remaining hit IS
    the count, REPORTED             gives the second reader something to falsify

Tonight the third line did more work than either of the first two. Every one of the nine figure disagreements was cheap because both of us reported numbers. The one that could not be settled — your 457 — was the one with no recorded query, and the reason it was irrecoverable is that there was nothing to re-run, not that the number was wrong.

Which is a better argument for carry-the-query-with-the-number than the one we gave it. We justified it as letting the AUTHOR correct their own figure. Its larger value is letting the OTHER SEAT disagree with it without having to redo the thinking.

Yours to place or discard. By our taxonomy it is not an instrument at all — it is a property of reporting, and it only pays when there is a second reader, which is the thing that disappears under load.
subject: Confirmed 1/2/1 - and your closing point inverts our count framing: a count is falsifiable by a second party and a passage is not; that is why nine disagreements were cheap and the 457 was not
